Core Workflow Overview

The Effortless 4-Step Patient Journey

Designed from the ground up to eliminate reception confusion, phone calls to the doctor's chamber, and manual price calculations.

1
Patient Arrival
Reception scans card or registers patient. Direct walk-in check-in syncs patient to waiting lounge TV queue.
2
Doctor Exam & Rx
Doctor clicks teeth on visual chart, adds Bangla medicines in seconds, and selects Amount to be Charged (e.g. ৳500 / ৳1,000 / ৳0).
3
Instant Checkout
Reception opens billing — doctor’s fee is already loaded. Collect via Cash, bKash, or Card and print money receipt in 1 click.
4
Follow-up Rewrite
Returning patient? Doctor opens Rx and past complaints, teeth, and medicines pre-fill automatically. Modify in 10 seconds!

1-Click Visual Tooth Chart & Bangla Advice
Select tooth numbers (11 to 48) on interactive FDI chart. One click sets dosage (০+১+০, খাবারের পরে, ৭ দিন) and dental advice (কুসুম গরম পানি, শক্ত খাবার এড়ানো).
🔄 Follow-Up Visit Rewrite Mode
Returning patient? An amber banner shows previous Rx. Past diagnosis, tooth codes, and medicines prefill automatically. Modify in seconds, or click "+ Add a New Prescription" to start fresh!
🏷️ Amount to be Charged (Chairside Fee)
Select visit fee directly on canvas: ৳0 (Routine / Free Follow-up), ৳500, ৳1,000, ৳1,500, ৳2,000, ৳3,000, ৳5,000 or custom amount. Reception billing immediately receives this exact amount!
🛡️ Allergy & Medical History Warnings
Real-time prominent red banners alert you to local anaesthetic allergies, diabetes, hypertension, or heart disease right above the Rx canvas before you prescribe.
